title.en: Imposition of a Mandated Price Ceiling on Imported Rice

text.en:
Mandated Price Ceiling on Imported Rice. A mandated price ceiling of fifty pesos per kilogram
(P50.00/kg) on imported rice (5% broken) shall be implemented for thirty (30) days nationwide, unless earlier
lifted by the President upon recommendation of the NPCC.

Periodic Review. The NPCC shall conduct a periodic review of the implementation of the price
ceiling every fifteen (15) days, and recommend to the President the continuation, adjustment or lifting thereof
based on prevailing market conditions and available data as may be necessary.

Agency Directives. To ensure the immediate and effective implementation of this Order, all
concerned agencies are directed to undertake coordinated actions within their respective mandates, as follows:
The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) and the Department of Agriculture (DA) shall ensure the strict

and uniform enforcement of the price ceiling, including the monitoring and investigation of abnormal price
movements. The Department of the Interior and Local Government is directed to provide the necessary
support to this purpose;
The Bureau of Customs shall conduct inspections and enforcement operations to combat hoarding, smuggling,
and illegal importation of rice, including the confiscation, seizure, or forfeiture of smuggled rice, as
The Philippine Competition Commission, in coordination with the DTI and DA, shall take appropriate
measures against cartelization, abuse of dominance, and other anti-competitive practices to ensure fair market
competition and protect consumer welfare; and
The Philippine National Police and other law enforcement agencies shall provide the necessary support to
ensure the immediate and effective enforcement of this Order.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Order shall be held invalid or unconstitutional, the
provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All orders, rules, and regulations, and other issuances or parts thereof which are
inconsistent with the provisions of this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take immediately upon its publication in the Official Gazette or a
newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 13th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Six.
(Sgd.) FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR.
By the President:
(Sgd.) RALPH G. RECTO
Acting Executive Secretary
